In either case the maximum exists and is at least E/2^n.

overlap.comparison: Its general complete-parity-core proof uses the same midpoint containment and half-scale volume floor for positive outside fibers. The present census adds all-fiber containment, a sharp global shell cutoff even for zero-volume nonempty fibers, and the sharpness family.

Its same-anchor construction gives the one-outside-base shell realization for simplex cores and positive added volumes. The present statement covers arbitrary convex K, gives the converse in the base census, and treats arbitrary compact convex sources.
